data.desc: GEN (Nasdaq:GENK) is a consumer-packaged goods company bringing authentic Korean BBQ and other Korean foods into home kitchens nationwide. Founded in 2011 by two Korean immigrants in Los Angeles, GEN built one of the leading Korean BBQ brands in the United States and now packages its signature recipes for at-home dining, led by ready-to-cook marinated meats. GEN products are sold nationwide through the likes of Albertsons, Costco, and other leading warehouse club and grocery retailers. The global rise of Korean culture - from K-pop and K-dramas to film and social media - has fueled robust growth in demand for Korean food, and GEN is positioned to bring that demand into homes across America.
